body.brief: The ENTIRE episode takes place at ONE single location: the Big Oak Tree (an enormous ancient oak on a low hill, with a rope swing, scattered acorns and a carved 'MEET HERE' sign). Do NOT switch settings — every scene stays at the Big Oak. Pip discovers a mysterious smooth egg nestled among the oak's roots. The trio wonder whose egg it is and decide to keep it warm; there is one clear funny beat (Bo's gag), one tender emotional beat, and the KEY MOMENT is the egg finally hatching into a little duckling. All dialogue spoken in clear English.
body.lesson: With patience and teamwork, you can care for something until it is ready.
body.angle: Pip the curious discoverer; Mo the calm explainer; Bo the comic relief
